test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A camp has provisions for 20 pupils for 13 days. In how many days will the same provisions be used up, if the strength of the camp is increased to 65 pupils?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use inverse proportion (more people ⇒ fewer days)

Days = 13 × (20 ÷ 65)

= 260 ÷ 65

= 4 days

**∴ Answer = 4 days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

20 pupils can consume food in 13 days

Required: days for 65 pupils

**Formula used:**

Total consumption = pupils × days (constant)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total work = 20 × 13 = 260 pupil-days

⇒ Days for 65 pupils = 260 ÷ 65

⇒ Days = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Proportion

More people consume resources faster, so days decrease.

Man-Days Concept

Total work = number of persons × number of days remains constant.

Quick Trick

Days = (Old persons × Old days) ÷ New persons.
